subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI chat auto-render remote http/https Markdown image URLs from chat/model content, and under what trust policy?
rationale: Current main deliberately blocks this at the renderer, CSP, docs, and tests, while the requested UX change would let rendered chat content make third-party browser image requests.

options.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
options.body: Preserve the current secure default and require same-origin, data/blob, explicit open/download, or a future approved media surface for remote content.

options.title: Add opt-in remote image rendering
options.body: Approve an operator-controlled setting or allowlist and update renderer, CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof together so the fetch behavior is explicit.

options.title: Design click-to-load or proxy media
options.body: Support inline media without automatic third-party browser fetches by adding a controlled proxy or user action first.

recommendation.title: Keep no-remote-fetch default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current secure default and require same-origin, data/blob, explicit open/download, or a future approved media surface for remote content.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice centers on the Control UI browser-fetch and CSP security policy that drobison00 most directly touched in merged history.
